decision: Complete association role excluded from P; exact existing intent envelope slot plus separate owner proof and protected-effect trace. No new authority or producer.

timing.beforeIntentHash: Fix exact body, expected package and either no association or immutable resolvable envelope binding/bytes.
timing.beforeDomainPass: Separate owner proof must be complete, eligible and exact for envelope digest, authoritative family and fixed commit class.
timing.validationPhaseProof: Permitted dependency order if independently completed before the verdict consumes it. No existing producer is claimed.
timing.openOwnerInterface: Actual proof artifact/schema, producer, admission/reuse/context and availability milestone. A late CommitIngressResult is not automatically the earlier classification proof.
